text:
eli_marketing: Quick idea 
Run a "Starter Sprint": three 7-min how-tos + one 20-min live teardown. Target: refapp forks, trial claims, and benchmark insights. Low friction. Thoughts?

sam_devrel: love it. keep each as a repo with a single-page README and a live demo. tiny CI that deploys the demo is helpful.

nora_growth: gating suggestion: require email + company size for webinar RSVP. route leads: small teams -> community drip, >50 -> sales. Capture UTM.

diego_eng: I can build bench scripts. metrics: p50/p95, tokens/sec, cost/token. will include a reproducibility header. sample: `python bench.py --model redwood-small --seq 512 --requests 200`

maya_design: I will do three hero tiles + an email banner. need final titles + short descriptions by Wed noon.

eli_marketing: Messaging split test: A: "Build LLM features faster" B: "Lower inference cost, same quality" We'll run 48h and pick winner.

sam_devrel: CTA in each README: 1) run locally 2) try hosted API token 3) RSVP demo. also add a demo modal snippet for capture.

nora_growth: I'll wire Segment -> HubSpot mapping. add github_handle field to sign-up so we can track forks.

diego_eng: small note: lock model version and instance in bench CSV: helps reproducibility.

sched_bot: calendar check OK for week of Sep 6.

eli_marketing: Owners: content = Sam, benchmarks = Diego, design = Maya, routing = Nora. Check-in Fri 11am.

maya_design: will queue assets after copy.

sam_devrel: will scaffold repos today.

eli_marketing: closing thread. I'll post a 1-pager with launch checklist afterwards.
